summary: BCB Bancorp filed an 8-K announcing an underwritten public common stock offering alongside a balance-sheet cleanup: management identified and is marketing ~$210M principal of problem loans, ~$27M of weak commercial real estate loans, and its cannabis-focused business (≈$69M cannabis loans, ≈$70M related deposits) for sale. Roughly $96M of loans transfer to held for sale in Q3 2026. Q3 provision is guided to $112-120M, including an ≈$87M pre-tax loss; an ≈$50M deferred-tax valuation allowance drives an expected $126.2-136.1M net loss. Watch pricing, buyer identity, and whether a capital raise backstops credit losses.
